trajectory_summary: This is a calm, low-friction call that moved steadily toward a booked appointment despite an unusual mid-call complication (a utility billing/metering mix-up). The rep stayed patient through a slow bill-retrieval process and secured a specific day, time, and channel. Energy neither spiked nor collapsed — it built steadily through cooperation rather than through any standout persuasive move.
outcome_dispute: None on the appointment itself — day, time, and channel are explicit. However, the co-owner (wife) was identified on title at 02:11 and never invited onto the 9AM call, which is a real gap in an otherwise clean booking.

observed_outcome.reasoning: A specific day (tomorrow) and time (9AM) were locked with a phone-call channel confirmed at 07:06-07:28; the co-owner wife was identified on title at 02:11 but never confirmed for the appointment.
